title: Second moment of a $\pm 1$-valued function
statement: Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a $\pm 1$-valued function, so that $f(x) \in \{-1, 1\}$ for every $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then, with respect to the uniform measure, $\E[f^2] = 1$; that is, $2^{-n}\sum_{x \in \{0,1\}^n} f(x)^2 = 1$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
